summary: Iteration 16 — Relocation of theme (dark/light) + brightness (darkLevel) UI from dashboard sidebar into Psy Chart Setting full-page editor VERIFIED across all 12 review items on https://controller-dashboard-2.preview.emergentagent.com. The DIM percentage badge + brightness slider have been completely removed from /dashboard.html (dark-level-slider count=0, dark-level-slider-wrap count=0) while venue-preset-chip, standards-btn, collector-config-btn, reset-modal-sizes-btn all still render correctly. On /setup.html?force=1 → Psy Chart Setting tile, the new 'Display Mode' block renders FIRST in the right rail (above the Givoni toggle, confirmed via compareDocumentPosition) with exactly 1 [data-testid='psy-cfg-theme-block'], 1 [data-testid='psy-cfg-theme-dark'], 1 [data-testid='psy-cfg-theme-light'] and 1 [data-testid='psy-cfg-dark-level'] range slider. Block text contains 'Display Mode' label. Light-mode click → Save & return writes localStorage['red5.theme']='light' AND localStorage['red5.darkLevel']='3' exactly; navigating to /dashboard.html confirms theme stays 'light' and 15 elements with .bg-slate-100/.bg-white classes mount (light surface). Dark-mode click + slider drag to 2.4 → save writes 'dark' + 2.4 (±0.05) and re-entering the page hydrates the slider back to 2.4 with the dark button keeping the active yellow styling. Slider container becomes 'pointer-events-none' (disabled) when Light is selected, and 'enabled' when Dim/Dark is selected. Regression: red5_sweet_spot_range + red5_rh_preset are still written by Save & return alongside the new theme keys. Screenshot confirms Display Mode block at top of right rail with Dim/Dark active (yellow accent) and 200% brightness slider.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Setup walk tiles in /setup.html?force=1 are class='tile-btn' <button> elements — the canonical selector is `page.locator('.tile-btn').all()` with .nth(0)=PSY CHART SETTING, .nth(1)=LOCATION, .nth(2)=LANGUAGE, .nth(3)=PLUG-IN. There are NO data-testid attributes on the tiles themselves (consider adding e.g. data-testid='setup-tile-psy' in a future iteration for cleaner test selectors). Psy Chart Setting page uses data-testid='psy-cfg-theme-block', 'psy-cfg-theme-dark', 'psy-cfg-theme-light', 'psy-cfg-dark-level'. Save button has visible text 'Save & return ✓' (Unicode tick); using a regex /save\s*&\s*return|save.*return/i is the safest match. The slider container's disabled state can be detected by walking up to 6 ancestor levels checking for either 'pointer-events-none' OR 'opacity-40' class — both indicate the LIGHT-mode disabled state.
rca of the issue: Original feature request was a clean relocation — not a bug fix. Main agent (a) deleted the DIM slider div from sidebar.js and replaced it with a 7-line explanatory comment, (b) extended PsyChartSettingPage state and hydrate/save effects to cover red5.theme + red5.darkLevel, (c) added the new Display Mode block (theme buttons + brightness slider) as the FIRST element of PsyControlPanel above the Givoni toggle. Data contract preserved: same two localStorage keys are read by dashboard app.js's useState lazy initializers at boot, so changing them from the new setup-walk UI has the same downstream effect as the (now-removed) sidebar slider had. All 12 verification points PASS — no regressions observed.
